title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
不同于传统守旧的老一辈，在信息时代成长起来的罗伯特等人经常在网上冲浪，接触的信息面广，思维跳脱，其实细说起来，跟其他那些美国普通年轻人没什么区别。在准备好之后，他们按照米娜的计划紧锣密鼓行动了起来。第一步，年纪最大的黄皮肤少年假装客人进入银行，出其不意掏出假枪劫持人质，要求银行内的几名持枪警卫弃枪投降。第二步，在解除最大的威胁后，其他人也戴着劫匪专用头套冲进来，将银行内的工作人员和客户迅速控制住，并且要求他们切断电源，方便后续卢克和米娜两人偷偷潜入银行保险库。。。。。说实话，第一次干这种事情，四人嘴上说的轻松，其实都很紧张。但让人意外的是，事情出乎意料地顺利，他们四人初出茅庐的半大小子还真就把宾夕法尼亚州最大的银行抢了。所有人都按照他们的话乖乖配合，全程没有出现任何意外。“谢特，原来抢银行这么简单的吗？！！”罗伯特都惊了，第一次发现银行劫匪原来是个入职门槛这么低的职业。难怪美国每年都会发生数千起银行抢劫案。感情大家都发现了这片蓝海啊。还没等罗伯特感慨完，他带着的无线电耳机里就传出姐姐米娜的声音。再三确定他们已经控制住了局面，没有出现人员伤亡后，米娜心中松了口气，向一旁早就准备好的卢克道：“卢克表哥，该轮到我们出动了。”“好。”卢克早就在等这一刻了。离进入银行保险库只有一墙之隔，他隐约间已经感应到了雨神特拉洛克对自己的呼唤。这种感应从未有这么强烈过。以至于卢克都有点控制不住体内汹涌澎湃起来的力量，在米娜有些吃惊的目光下，他的体型膨胀了一圈，手臂肌肉高高鼓起，泛着如同金属般的冷硬光泽。“卢克表哥，这就是神灵赐予你的力量吗？”米娜有些惊叹地上前摸了一下，发现这位便宜表哥的手臂现在简直比钢铁还硬，其中仿佛蕴藏着某种惊心动魂的力量。“嗯，我之前还不知道神灵为什么会选中我，但现在我可能明白了，这是神灵赐予我的使命……”这段时间的经历显然完全扭转了卢克的信仰，让他从一个其实不怎么信神的泛信徒，转而开始相信冥冥之中的宿命。但他们不知道的是。他们的行动之所以进展这么顺利，是因为调查组刚才用窃听设备监控了他们的无线电频道，对他们的计划了若指掌。此时听到卢克这带有浓浓宿命感的话语，一直镇定自若，认为卢克.邓肯不会脱离他掌控的乔治.詹特利，心中突然升起一股浓浓的不祥预感。他发现自己对卢克.邓肯的心理行为侧写可能出错了。对方来这里抢银行，不只是为了帮表弟表妹凑手术费，还有着一个更重要的目的。这个目的甚至有可能跟他目前所拥有的超能力有关！！！“呼……不能等下去了。”

意识到事情逐渐脱离他掌控的乔治.詹特利，立即推翻了自己原定的计划，拿起对讲机，向埋伏在银行四周，以及银行内部的人手下达了指令。嘭！嘭嘭！！一瞬间，形势就发生了翻天覆地的变化。刚才还在卢克等人假枪面前积极配合，喏喏不敢言的银行工作人员，摇身一变，突然变得勇猛无比。三下五除二的功夫，他们几人就全部被制服，压着脖颈按倒在地。就连他们之中最能打的黄皮肤少年，都没能挺过一个回合。而在朦胧的雨幕之中，更是响起武装直升机和无人机组起飞的声音。“啊？？！”这大场面把罗伯特看懵了。愣了足足有三秒钟，他才反应过来这些人应该是冲着卢克表哥来的。“姐，你和卢克表哥快跑！！”罗伯特挣扎着大喊。但他耳朵上的无线电耳机早在被制服的那一刻，就被假扮成银行工作人员的FBI特工卸下。这会儿声音根本传不了那么远他们只能眼睁睁看着一队队国民警卫队的士兵靠着装甲车、坦克，从附近的停车场里出来，将美国第一国家银行团团包围。与此同时，在乔治.詹特利的命令下，这四个珍贵的人质也被转移到了其中一辆装甲车上。而他自己则站在一排排国民警卫队士兵后面，手里拿着扩音器，开始了最后一次招降。“卢克.邓肯，你已经被包围了，这周围有超过三十辆装甲车和坦克，和一千名全副武装的国民警卫队士兵。”“天上也有超过十架武装直升机时刻巡视。”“你不可能从这里逃出去。”“现在投降的话，我保证老约翰之前对你说的话仍然有效，联邦政府不会追究你任何的罪责，你和你身边的表妹会有最光明的未来，你的琳达阿姨也会得到最好的医疗资源救治。”站在一个普通美国人的角度，乔治.詹特利说的这些话不可谓不诱人。事实上，这是乔治.詹特利背后的专家智囊团队加班加点研究了十几个小时的工作成果。他们深刻刨析卢克.邓肯的人生经历以及性格，认为在这种话术下，卢克.邓肯有很大可能会选择投降，这对大家都好。而他们的分析推断其实也没错。如果没有经历那两场无比真实的梦境的话，这是卢克会考虑做出的决定。可是现在。银行保险库里。顺着冥冥之中的感应，徒手撕开一个保险柜，拿到了里面那张存放上百年，他在梦中见过很多次的雨神特拉洛克面具，卢克陷入了沉默。他想起了战士修尔斯在月亮金字塔上，向大祭司发下的誓言。他说，他要用自己的生命和灵魂守护这件阿兹特克人的圣物。“我也如此！！”卢克做出了自己的选择。
content_en:
Different from the traditional and conservative older generation, Robert and others who grew up in the information age often surfed the Internet, were exposed to a wide range of information, and had out-of-the-box thinking. In fact, in detail, they were no different from other ordinary young people in the United States.After getting ready, they started to act in full swing according to Mina's plan.In the first step, the oldest yellow-skinned boy pretended to be a customer and entered the bank. Unexpectedly, he took out a fake gun and took the hostages. He asked several armed guards in the bank to abandon their guns and surrender.In the second step, after the biggest threat was eliminated, other people also rushed in wearing robber hoods, quickly controlled the staff and customers in the bank, and asked them to cut off the power supply, so that Luke and Mina could sneak into the bank vault later.....To be honest, it was the first time they did this kind of thing. The four of them said they were relaxed, but in fact they were very nervous.But what is surprising is that things went unexpectedly smoothly, and the four of them, just as young as they were, actually robbed the largest bank in Pennsylvania.Everyone cooperated obediently as they were told, and there were no accidents throughout the process."Shet, is it so easy to rob a bank?!" Robert was shocked. It was the first time he discovered that bank robbers were a profession with such a low entry barrier.It’s no wonder that thousands of bank robberies occur every year in the United States.Everyone has discovered this blue ocean of emotions.Before Robert could finish his emotion, his sister Mina's voice came from the radio earphone he was wearing.After confirming again and again that they had the situation under control and there were no casualties, Mina breathed a sigh of relief and said to Luke, who had been prepared for a long time: "Cousin Luke, it's our turn to take action." "Okay." Luke had been waiting for this moment.There was only a wall separating him from entering the bank vault, and he had vaguely sensed the call of the rain god Tlaloc to him.This feeling has never been so strong.So much so that Luke couldn't control the surging power in his body. Under Mina's somewhat surprised gaze, his body swelled, and his arm muscles bulged high, glowing with a cold and hard sheen like metal."Cousin Luke, is this the power given to you by the gods?" Mina stepped forward to touch it in amazement, and found that this cheap cousin's arm was now harder than steel, and it seemed to contain some kind of thrilling power."Well, I didn't know why the gods chose me before, but now I may understand that this is the mission given to me by the gods..." The experience during this period obviously completely changed Luke's faith, turning him from a pan-believer who didn't really believe in gods to starting to believe in destiny.But what they don't know is.The reason why their operation went so smoothly was because the investigation team had just used eavesdropping equipment to monitor their radio channels and knew their plans well.At this time, when he heard Luke's words with a strong sense of fate, George Gentry, who had always been calm and composed, thinking that Luke Duncan would not escape his control, suddenly felt a strong sense of foreboding in his heart.He discovered that his psychological behavioral profile of Luke Duncan might have been wrong.The other party came here to rob the bank not only to help his cousin collect surgery fees, but also had a more important purpose.This purpose may even be related to the superpower he currently possesses!!!"Huh...can't wait any longer."

Realizing that things were gradually getting out of his control, George Gentry immediately overturned his original plan, picked up the walkie-talkie, and gave instructions to the people ambushing around the bank and inside the bank.Bang!Bang bang!!In an instant, the situation changed drastically.The bank staff who had been actively cooperating in front of Luke and others' fake guns just now, but who dared not say anything suddenly changed and suddenly became extremely brave.In a matter of seconds, they were all subdued and pushed to the ground with their necks pressed down.Even the most capable yellow-skinned boy among them could not survive a round.And in the hazy rain curtain, the sound of armed helicopters and drone groups taking off could be heard."Huh??!" Robert was confused by this big scene.After being stunned for three seconds, he realized that these people were probably coming for Cousin Luke."Sister, you and Cousin Luke run!" Robert struggled and shouted.But the radio headphones on his ears had been removed by FBI agents posing as bank staff as early as the moment he was subdued.At this moment, the sound couldn't travel that far at all. They could only watch as groups of National Guard soldiers backed by armored vehicles and tanks came out of a nearby parking lot and surrounded the First National Bank of the United States.At the same time, under the order of George Gentry, these four precious hostages were also transferred to one of the armored vehicles.And he himself stood behind rows of National Guard soldiers, holding a loudspeaker in his hand, and began the final call for surrender."Luke Duncan, you have been surrounded. There are more than thirty armored vehicles and tanks around you, and a thousand fully armed National Guard soldiers." "There are also more than ten armed helicopters patrolling the sky at all times." "You can't escape from here." "If you surrender now, I guarantee Old JohnWhat I said to you before is still valid. The federal government will not hold you responsible for any crime.You and your cousin will have the brightest future, and your Aunt Linda will also receive the best medical resources." From the perspective of an ordinary American, these words said by George Gentry are not unattractive.In fact, this is the result of more than ten hours of overtime research by the expert think tank team behind George Gentry.They deeply analyzed Luke Duncan's life experience and character, and believed that under this kind of rhetoric, Luke Duncan would most likely choose to surrender, which would be good for everyone.And their analysis and inference are actually correct.If he hadn't experienced those two extremely real dreams, this was a decision Luke would have considered making.But now.In a bank vault.Following the induction, he tore open a safe with his bare hands and got the mask of Tlaloc, the rain god, which had been stored for hundreds of years and which he had seen many times in his dreams. Luke fell into silence.He remembered the oath the warrior Sholes swore to the high priest on the Pyramid of the Moon.He said he would protect this Aztec sacred object with his life and soul."Me too!!" Luke made his choice.
